mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained federal funds rate increase above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening that elevates discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a demand contraction that triggers policy stimulus expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate fiscal/monetary support.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points within one month signals labor market improvement that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and falls > 0.2pp, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production decline below 100 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction that triggers policy stimulus, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate economic support.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained consumer price index increase above 2.5% for three consecutive months signals accelerating inflation that prompts immediate Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to policy shifts.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100,000 new jobs/month) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without regime-specific conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index increase (CPIAUCSL) indicate policy response to disinflation that reduces real interest rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year window.
